d: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed addresses the historic significance of his campaign as voters head to the polls in a closely watched 2026 US midterm election. Asked about the possibility of becoming the first Muslim elected to the US Senate, El-Sayed says he is not running to make history but to become “the next senator for Michigan.” El-Sayed says a victory would send a message that America is big enough for people of all backgrounds, while pledging to focus on the issues affecting Michigan voters.
